settings.kernelAutoUpdate.label: Update kernel at startup
settings.kernelAutoUpdate.description: Let the language server check and download the kernel and the template catalog when it starts. Off keeps it to what is already on disk, and ncm build does the download.
settings.autoCheck.label: Check syntax automatically
settings.autoCheck.description: Check the project when it opens, on save and when a watched file changes. Off keeps the current problems until it is turned back on.
settings.watch.label: Watch files for changes
settings.watch.description: Re-check when sources are changed outside the editor. Off limits checks to opening and saving in the editor.
settings.completionBuild.label: Build compilation for completion
settings.completionBuild.description: Let C# completion build the project compilation when it is not cached yet. Off keeps completion to a compilation that already exists in this session, so a large project never starts a silent full build.
settings.projectLoad.label: Load projects
settings.projectLoad.description: On demand registers a project when a file or the page touches it, and follows the projects it references. All registers every ncproj in the workspace at startup.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.description: Page language. Empty follows the editor language.
settings.langServerPath.label: Language server path
settings.langServerPath.description: Path to NacreCraft.NcMod.LangServer.dll. Empty uses the bundled server.
settings.nugetSources.label: NuGet sources
settings.nugetSources.description: Feeds the NuGet tab searches, separated by semicolons. A v3 index or a search endpoint both work.
settings.nugetFocus.label: Close side bars for NuGet
settings.nugetFocus.description: Close the primary and secondary side bars when the NuGet page opens, so the page gets the full width.
settings.nugetDetailWidth.label: Description pane width
settings.nugetDetailWidth.description: Default width of the package description pane in pixels.
settings.nugetDetailHeight.label: Description pane height
settings.nugetDetailHeight.description: Default height of the package description pane in pixels.
settings.logHeight.label: Log height
settings.logHeight.description: Height of the log at the bottom in pixels. Dragging its top edge changes the value and saves it.
